system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: AnyTool is initiated upon receiving a queryQ, the function list detailed in Ta- ble 8, and a bootstrap prompt as outlined in Section B.1 of the appendix.
system_prompt_style.note: Paper-only; prompt code (anytool/prompt_template.py) listed in file tree but not opened. The solver gets a different bootstrap prompt on reflection (Sec. 4.3). The quote is taken from PDF text with line-break hyphenation.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Each type of agent is assigned several functions that it can use to explore the API space.
env_context_strategy.note: Hierarchical agents explore the API space (categories, tools and APIs) through function calls.

context_compaction.note: Code was not available in the evidence. The paper describes removing failed API calls from the solver history on reflection, but does not describe a compaction mechanism.

observation_format.evidence_quote: The results produced by these functions are subsequently incorporated into the historical context

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: AnyTool is powered by the function calling feature of GPT-4

tool_count.note: The number of functions depends on the agent tier (see Fig. 2). The solver's tools are dynamic, drawn from the API candidate pool (up to 64) plus finish.

edit_primitive.note: Fig. 2 lists the function registry, and it contains no file-editing function. B3 is a multi-valued dimension, so this should strictly be written as [none]; recorded as the string 'none' here. The value is out of domain: this is not a SWE agent.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: The functionality ofFi is elaborated in a specific document that outlines its purpose, required and optional parameters

protocol_standardization.note: No dependency file contents were in the evidence to grep.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Two potential implementations for the solver are the Depth- First Search-Based Decision Tree (DFSDT) or the Chain of Thought (CoT) approach.
loop_primitives.note: Default is DFSDT (tree_search); CoT is the react-style alternative. The self-reflection loop adds generate_test_repair.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: a bootstrap prompt detailed in Section B.2 of the appendix

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The hierarchical structure includes a meta-agent linked with several category agents, each of which manages a collection of tool agents.
multi_agent_topology.note: There is a subsequent pipeline hand-off from retriever to solver.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: These functions may involve creating a specific agent (either a category agent or a tool agent)

short_term_state.evidence_quote: we record the historical context and sta- tus of each agent
short_term_state.note: The harness also keeps a global API candidate pool.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Upon receiving a query, AnyTool suggests a solution, which is then evaluated for feasibility by GPT-4.
self_verification.note: anytool/check_solved.py and anytool/verifier.py appear in the file tree but were not opened.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: this mechanism can be applied repeatedly until the termination condition is met.
retry_policy.note: The paper reports 4-6 reflection rounds in practice; the cap is not reported.

rollback.note: DFSDT backtracking is over the search tree, not a rollback of changes.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: This cycle continues until the solver gives a “Give Solution” or “Give Up” decision.
termination_condition.note: The retriever also stops when the candidate pool is full (--max_api_number 64).

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: We use over 16K real-world APIs from the RapidAPI Hub
execution_isolation.note: Actions are HTTP calls to RapidAPI and the ToolBench server; the local process is not sandboxed.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: The pass rate can be found in the success_cnt.txt under the output directory.

target_domain.evidence_quote: a large language model agent designed to revolutionize the utilization of a vast array of tools in addressing user queries.
target_domain.note: The quote is taken from PDF text with line-break hyphenation.

open_source.note: The LICENSE file itself was not shown.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: We use Azure OpenAI for all our experiments.
model_agnostic.note: The system relies on GPT-4 function calling.
